name: Lima Sheet Metal
old_description: Family-owned and operated since 1974, serving Ohio with quality metal
about:
Lima Sheet Metal has operated from Lima, Ohio since 1974, when founder Michael Ray Emerick opened a small fabrication shop to serve the local community. The business remains family-owned and women-owned, now in its third generation under the leadership of CEO Anne Emerick, President James "Bo" Emerick, and General Manager Steve Emerick.

The company runs a full-service machine shop offering sheet metal fabrication, structural steel work, ventilation and duct systems, material handling equipment, and custom machining. In-house capabilities include CNC and manual machining, MIG/TIG/stick welding, press brakes with 12-foot capacity, a plasma cutting table, and certified confined space entry for tank and vessel work. They also provide on-site installation, emergency welding repair, and specialized fabrication for food and restaurant facilities.

Lima Sheet Metal serves industrial, commercial, and municipal customers throughout Ohio. Its client base includes manufacturers needing custom enclosures, guardrails, and production line components, as well as food-processing plants requiring sanitary stainless steel equipment and ventilation hoods.

The firm emphasizes complete in-house control from design through installation, fast turnaround on quotes (within 24 hours), and emergency repair services to minimize downtime. Three generations of the Emerick family oversee a team of certified welders and machinists who maintain rigorous quality standards on every project.
